meta.title: Provider websites: one program, many company sites
meta.footer_right: How it works, from the beginning

ladder.says: A provider website is a rental company's own public site, built and run by us.
One shared application serves every company, instead of a separate copy each.
The web address a visitor types is what decides whose site they see.
Most visits are answered at the edge by a cache, never reaching the application.
Adding a company means adding an address and a certificate, not another copy.
The site displays RentOS data; RentOS stays the single source of truth.

blocks.title: Method
items: The claim that most visits stop at the edge is a design target for the full-page cache, not a figure observed in production.
The planning target agreed for the first two years is 500 or more company sites.
This document explains what the thing is. The choice between the five candidate designs, and the scores behind it, is a separate document written for the team that has to build it.
